title: Chapter 125: Opportunity To Change Destiny
content:
Chapter 125: Opportunity To Change Destiny

Gong Zhe was a little surprised when his host said that what was in the bag was energy coins. As far as he knew, the lords in this remote area all used luck beads to purchase goods and rarely used energy coins.

Out of courtesy and business ethics, Gong Zhe carefully took the bag and opened it in front of the host, only to find that it was full of golden Zerg energy coins.

The golden light of the Zerg energy coin made Gong Zhe's eyes flash. He had never seen such a beautiful energy coin before!

He gently picked up a golden energy coin, and as soon as he felt it, his expression immediately changed. He no longer cared about the professional ethics of a businessman.

"Where did this energy coin come from?!"

Gong Zhe asked the host with a serious face.

"This is the energy coin used by our clan."

The host answered truthfully.

"Who is the noble?"

Gong Zhe was even more surprised now. Only now did he realize that he had always ignored the host's race. This was a bit unbelievable for him, who was always shrewd.

"This is a member of the powerful Zerg race that is behind our independent territory alliance!"

"The Zerg are a race that has just entered the world, and their understanding of this world is limited. That's why we need to purchase so many books!"

"These energy coins of the Zerg are all gifts from the great master of the Zerg. The territories of our alliance are all fortunate to receive the gift of the master!"

Hu Wei, who had been standing nearby for a while, came over and answered Gong Zhe's question before the host could.

Speaking of the gift of the Zerg master, he also took a small bag of Zerg energy coins from his arms and showed it to Gong Zhe.

Wu Qing saw Hu Wei snatching the words, and he understood Hu Wei's intention. Many words would be better if they were spoken by others. It is hard to praise yourself when you speak for yourself.

Wu Qing discussed the use of Zerg energy coins in the caravan with the lords of the alliance. Hu Wei, an old fox, knew Wu Qing's thoughts very well.

"Disrespectful! It turns out to be a new Zerg friend!"

"Any race that is new to the world! They are all friends of my goblin clan!"

"All the items purchased by the Zerg this time are discounted!"

After learning that the Zerg were a new race entering the world, Gong Zhe became more polite and couldn't help but show respect when facing the host.

Perhaps this world is in too much need of new blood. As long as you hear that the Zerg are a new race entering the world, no matter whether you are an enemy or a friend, you will have admiration for the Zerg.

"Thank you to the goblin clan for their generosity!"

The host did not reject Gong Zhe's kindness.

"Energy coins of this purity are of extremely important significance to our goblin clan!"

"If possible, I would like to purchase all the energy coins in your hands. The price can be determined by you!"

Gong Zhe looked at the bag of high-purity energy coins in his hand and said solemnly to the host and Hu Wei.

"All of our Zerg products can be paid for with Zerg energy coins."

"You guys need to evaluate the value of the Zerg energy coins first."

The host replied.

"Our various territories do not receive many Zerg energy coins, and the purchased goods can only be partially paid for with Zerg energy coins."

Hu Wei replied.

"Thank you to the Zerg and the Independent Territory Alliance for supporting our clan! Your friendship will be remembered by our clan!"

"I can give the highest valuation within my authority for the valuation of this energy coin, and price it at twenty times the standard energy coin. How about it?"

"If you are not satisfied with this price, I can apply to the clan for a higher price, but this will take a certain amount of time!"

Gong Zhe first expressed his thanks, and then directly set the highest price within his authority for the Zerg energy coins.

The price of twenty times the standard energy coin has exceeded the expectations of Wu Qing and the alliance lords. People should not be too greedy.

As mentioned at the beginning, high-purity energy coins are very useful in some situations, but if the premium is too high, it will not be cost-effective to use them in general situations.

Things are more valuable when they are rare. If the number of Zerg Energy Coins is very small, the value will be very high.

Wu Qing can control the circulation of Zerg energy coins at any time as needed.

Wu Qing guessed that the reason why Gong Zhe valued the Zerg energy coins so much was related to the goblin clan's mechanical creations. This was just like technological products. The more sophisticated and powerful the product, the higher the energy requirements.

If this caravan were replaced by caravans of other races, it would be great if the Zerg energy coins could reach ten times the valuation of standard energy coins.

"Okay, we agree to the price."

The host directly agreed to Gong Zhe’s price, and Hu Wei did not object.

"Haha! Good!"

Gong Zhe's anxious heart finally relaxed and he laughed happily without concealing it.

He is very aware of the clan's need for pure energy sources. Many important researches in the clan require pure energy to drive. However, it is very difficult to improve the clan's energy purification technology, and there has been no breakthrough for a long time.

This time he was lucky enough to find an almost absolutely pure energy coin. Even if he couldn't get even one, he only had to provide this information to the clan and he would have made a great contribution.

He now has the opportunity to exchange for a large amount of pure energy coins at a price within his authority. This is definitely an incredible achievement. With this achievement, his life will be changed in the future!

That's why he couldn't help laughing.

"Please choose whatever products the Zerg need!"

"It doesn't matter if it's on credit!"

Gong Zhe has already begun to calculate how much Zerg energy coins the entire caravan's products are worth when added up.

Discounts and credit, such a good thing, Wu Qing certainly won't be polite, he started to add more goods, he wanted to buy everything he wanted.

He didn't need credit, he paid directly with the value of Zerg energy coins, and the energy resources consumed were not much.

Gong Zhe sent a message to the caravan, asking the caravan's main force to quickly complete the transaction with the Tengu clan and rush over immediately.

He couldn't wait to complete this transaction. According to the result of this transaction, he would immediately report to the clan, and his fate would also change at that moment!

The host waited for Wu Qing to select all the goods, and sent the new list of goods to Gong Zhe through mental power, asking Gong Zhe to calculate the total price.

Gong Zhe was proficient in arithmetic, and quickly calculated the price of the goods selected by Wu Qing according to the standard energy coin pricing.

He gave Wu Qing a big discount as he said before, and then converted the total price into Zerg energy coins.

This was a considerable number, which made him very happy.

The host received the offer, and several other tentacles rolled over several large bags, which were gently opened to reveal that they were full of Zerg energy coins.

"My companions! Hurry up! Here is our most distinguished guest!"

Gong Zhe personally shouted to the caravan that was rushing over.

A large number of goblin transport vehicles crawled over from the direction of the Tengu tribe camp.
